{{Lunisolar April}} 
'''April 4''' is the 4th day of month {{ill|April (Lunisolar)|ja|4月 (旧暦)|lt=April (Uzuki)}}  the 4th month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} . It's {{ill|Rokuyō|ja|六曜}}  day is {{ill|senshū|qid=Q96759839}}{{efn|ja|先勝|1=Rokuyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q9418169}}{{efn|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 六曜|1=Rokuyō|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q9418169}} .
